scope: Tesseract.js with existing same-origin traineddata; two original user photos; experimental Node canvas only, not browser acceptance
notes: No dictionary or machine translation was used to fill image meanings.
English boxes came from saved previous integration experiment; this experiment did not validate the current browser English regression.
Whitespace/punctuation is ignored only in the diagnostic Chinese-content metric.
Highest confidence is a deliberately simple blind selection baseline; ground truth was not used to choose it.
An oracle correct candidate found in a sweep is not an automatic end-to-end pass.
The extended What day is it today? row uses a manually specified next-line region during the scale experiment; automatic detection remains unimplemented.
findings: Single-language chi_sim plus foreground threshold around110 performs much better than original raw mixed-language OCR for Chinese meaning regions.
Direct English bbox height truncates taller or vertically shifted Chinese glyphs and leaks adjacent rows; independent Chinese segmentation is required.
The Chinese for What day is it today? is on its following line and belongs to that sentence before cinema.
English enhanced mask must not be reused for Chinese; it intentionally removes black Chinese glyphs.
Large-font Chinese variants remain wrong even with tightly cropped text: dance meaning 舞蹈→舞路 and walk meaning 牵/遛 unstable.
Engine confidence is not reliable proof of correctness; incorrect 舞路 scored75 while correct 舞蹈 scored50 in another mode.
Many sequential per-row retries add latency and cannot be shipped unbounded.
recommendation: Integrate one-to-one paired entries retaining image-derived Chinese; generate independent Chinese boxes from contrast-normalized image and associate by y overlap/next-line order. Mark low-confidence or inconsistent pairs for review. Do not claim 23/23 unless real browser path proves it; a stronger OCR engine may be required for reliable full-photo Chinese.
